name: UpperTheory.V.PropA.descends
source: ∀ (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (L₀ : Type) [Field L₀] [NumberField L₀], HasMuQ l L₀ →
∀ γ : G L₀ (AlgebraicClosure L₀), IsGen l ⊤ γ → Descends l L₀ γ := by
intro l _ L₀ _ _ hmu γ hγ e he m L₁ _ _ _ hL
exact step0 hmu hγ hne m L₁ hL
show: If the number field L₀ satisfies the prescribed roots-of-unity hypothesis at the prime ℓ, then every γ generating the cyclotomic image of its full absolute Galois group in the topological sense satisfies descent for all natural twists e ≥ 1 and all finite layers.
strategy: Use the arithmetic descent theorem for nonzero integral twists.

steps.claim: The natural twist e satisfies e ≥ 1, so its image in ℤ is nonzero. It therefore satisfies the twist hypothesis of the single-layer descent identity.

children.claim: The assumption e ≥ 1 is precisely strict positivity of the natural number e.
The inclusion of ℕ in ℤ preserves this strict positivity, so the integer representing e differs from zero.

steps.claim: The base field has the prescribed initial root of unity and κ(γ) topologically generates its cyclotomic image. For this nonzero integral twist and any level-m field L₁, single-layer descent equates the Sha length on L₁ for the negative twist −e with the length of the cokernel of (κ(γ)^e T)^(ℓ^m) − 1 on X_P, where T is the action of γ. This gives descent for every positive natural twist and every layer.

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
